name: Empty State
description: What a list, a search or a new project shows when there is nothing in it: a small drawing, a title, a line of help and the next step.

props.name: title
props.description: What is missing, in a few words.

props.name: description
props.description: One or two sentences under the title on what to do next.

props.name: illustration
props.description: One of four line drawings, each with one slow ambient motion that stops with reduced motion: a lens resting on a snow drift, a letter tray with a flake settling into it, an open folder with one sheet, a flag planted on a ridge.

props.name: icon
props.description: Shown instead of an illustration, in a round muted well. Sized to 24 pixels (20 at sm).

props.name: media
props.description: Any other picture, shown as it is. Used when neither illustration nor icon is set.

props.name: actions
props.description: Buttons under the text, primary first. They wrap and stay centred.

props.name: size
props.description: sm for panels and table bodies: a smaller picture and 32 pixels of padding. md has 48, lg has 64, a larger picture and a larger title.

props.name: bordered
props.description: Puts the content in a well with a dashed outline.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the root. Also accepts every attribute of a div.
